title: Validate Date Format DD/MM/YYYY

content.problemStatement: Write a program to find a specific date ,check wheteher the date is Valid or Not . Year will be in rangen 1900  to 9999
content.inputFormat: Accept three integer as a input
content.outputFormat: Print the date is valid or not

solution.approach: Validate a date formatted as DD/MM/YYYY with year in range [1900, 9999].
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Check year is in [1900, 9999], month in [1, 12], and day within valid days for the month (accounting for leap year in Feb).

hints: Year must be between 1900 and 9999 inclusive.
February has 29 days in a leap year, 28 otherwise.
learningObjectives: Account for varying month lengths and leap years.
